nodes.label: Composer Agent (adaptive workflow composer)
nodes.rationale: It is a scoring function, not a research agent: the output is a per-stage EXECUTE/SKIP grid grounded by five coarse scores, so it stops gathering evidence as soon as it can score confidently (target under four tool calls with CodeKB present) rather than mapping the codebase itself.

nodes.label: Autonomy Risk Score (IAE, CSU, VE, R, UA)
nodes.source_location: ### Step 2: Estimate the Autonomy Risk Score (ARS)
nodes.rationale: Estimated before looking at any stock scope so the grid is derived from the task's actual entropy rather than reverse-justified from a preferred scope; the LOW/MED/HIGH bands are continuous with no gaps so every score falls in exactly one band.

nodes.label: Minimum viable workflow (expected-value stage selection)
nodes.rationale: The right question is not whether AI can do this in one shot but what the least sufficient safe workflow is for this codebase; each added stage must reduce implementation entropy, failure cost, or verification weakness by more than it costs, and single-shot is valid only when it IS the minimum viable workflow.

nodes.label: Economy Discipline (fold overlapping stages)
nodes.rationale: Positive expected value is necessary but not sufficient for EXECUTE: two stages that both help are one justified stage plus one fold candidate, and folding is applied hardest in Ideation and Inception where framing stages overlap most and bloat accumulates fastest. Overlap is resolved by decomposing each stage's concrete output dimensions and keeping only the UNIQUE ones downstream stages consume.

nodes.label: Single structural evidence path (CodeKB-first, never blended)
nodes.source_location: ### Step 3: Select the Structural Evidence Source
nodes.rationale: CSU and the structural signals feeding VE draw from exactly one source, decided before scoring, because blending a pre-computed index with an ad-hoc scan produces incomparable evidence. When CodeKB is ready it REPLACES direct code scanning rather than supplementing it; the fallback scan is used only when CodeKB is absent, unindexed, or stale, and CodeKB is not re-attempted once fallback begins.

nodes.label: In-flight recomposition (frozen stages, ahead-of-cursor flips only)
nodes.rationale: Completed, in-progress, and skipped stages are frozen so recomposition cannot rewrite history; an ADD whose required producer is skipped or behind the cursor is rejected rather than proposed, and the composer emits only a proposal while the deterministic recompose verb owns the state write.
